nodes.name: orgScopeRepoFilter.ts
nodes.summary: Repo-scope predicate helpers that decide whether a workspace repo is eligible for an org-scoped picker or matches an org's configured repo scopes, used by scope pickers and admin filters.

nodes.name: getRepoScopeKeysForOrgFilter
nodes.summary: Derives the candidate normalized scope keys for a repo (from its remote URL or cached resolution) used by org-scope filtering.

nodes.name: evaluateOrgScope
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether a repo's scope keys are covered by an org's configured scopes, returning the matching org scope or null.

nodes.name: repoMatchesOrgScopes
nodes.summary: Predicate wrapper over evaluateOrgScope answering whether a repo matches any of an org's configured scopes.

nodes.name: repoEligibleForOrgScopedPicker
nodes.summary: Predicate for whether a repo should appear enabled in an org-scoped repo picker.

nodes.name: workspaceMatchesRepoFilter
nodes.summary: Applies an org-scope repo predicate to a workspace object, used by sidebar/session filtering.

nodes.name: repoScopeResolver.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves a local checkout's shareable scope keys (normalized git remote URLs) via the git-remotes IPC, with a module-wide cache, external-store subscription for React, and the reverse lookup from scope key back to a local checkout path.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses useSyncExternalStore-compatible subscribe/version primitives to expose an async-resolved cache synchronously to React consumers.

nodes.name: subscribeShareableScopeKeys
nodes.summary: External-store subscribe function for the shareable scope-key cache, notifying React consumers via useSyncExternalStore whenever the cache version bumps.

nodes.name: getShareableScopeKeyVersion
nodes.summary: Returns the current cache-version counter for the shareable scope-key cache, used as the external-store snapshot.

nodes.name: useShareableScopeKeyVersion
nodes.summary: Hook subscribing a component to the shareable scope-key cache version via useSyncExternalStore, re-rendering when any repo's resolved keys change.

nodes.name: peekShareableScopeKeys
nodes.summary: Synchronously reads a repo's cached shareable scope keys without triggering a new async resolution.

nodes.name: peekShareableScopeKey
nodes.summary: Synchronously reads the first cached shareable scope key for a repo path.

nodes.name: resolveShareableScopeKeys
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the full set of shareable scope keys for a local checkout via the git-remotes IPC, deduping in-flight requests and bumping the cache version on completion.

nodes.name: resolveShareableScopeKey
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper resolving just the first shareable scope key for a repo path.

nodes.name: primeShareableScopeKey
nodes.summary: Seeds the scope-key cache for a repo path ahead of time (e.g. from a known repo_url) to avoid an unnecessary IPC round-trip.

nodes.name: clearShareableScopeKeyCache
nodes.summary: Clears the entire shareable scope-key cache, used in tests and on major state resets.

nodes.name: resolveLocalCheckoutForScopeKey
nodes.summary: Reverse lookup: given a remote scope key, finds a local checkout path among a candidate set whose resolved scope keys include it.

nodes.name: sessionOrgTagsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom and pure helpers for the explicit per-session-to-org tag set ("share this session to org X now"), namespacing cloud org tokens as `cloud:<orgId>` while transparently skipping legacy bare-orgId self-hosted tokens.

nodes.name: cloudOrgToken
nodes.summary: Builds the namespaced `cloud:<orgId>` token used to represent a managed-cloud org inside the session-org-tags set.

nodes.name: isSessionExcludedFromPersonal
nodes.summary: Predicate for whether a session carries the sentinel token excluding it from the personal (untagged) bucket.

nodes.name: tokensForSession
nodes.summary: Returns the raw list of org-tag tokens stored for one session id, the shared read primitive the other helpers build on.

nodes.name: cloudOrgIdsForSession
nodes.summary: Extracts the set of cloud org ids a session is explicitly tagged to, skipping legacy bare-orgId self-hosted tokens.

nodes.name: isSessionTaggedToCloudOrg
nodes.summary: Predicate for whether a session carries the explicit tag for a specific cloud org.

nodes.name: taggedCloudOrgIds
nodes.summary: Returns all cloud org ids present across a session's org-tag set.

nodes.name: withTag
nodes.summary: Pure updater returning a session-org-tags map with one session's tag set extended to include a token.

nodes.name: withoutTag
nodes.summary: Pure updater returning a session-org-tags map with a token removed from one session's tag set, pruning the entry entirely when it becomes empty.

nodes.name: withoutCloudOrgTag
nodes.summary: Pure updater removing a specific cloud org's tag from a session, delegating to withoutTag with the namespaced token.

nodes.name: CollabSyncBackend.ts
nodes.summary: Backend contract (interfaces only) shared by the projects/work-items sync channel and the teammate-session replay/fork importers; the sole remaining implementation is the managed ORG2 Cloud adapter after the self-hosted track was removed.

nodes.name: collabGzip.ts
nodes.summary: Gzip and canonical-serialization helpers for the segments data plane, using native CompressionStream/DecompressionStream so both renderer and test environments exercise the real codec without a zlib shim.

nodes.name: pipeThroughStream
nodes.summary: Pipes a byte buffer through a native CompressionStream or DecompressionStream and collects the result into a single Uint8Array.

nodes.name: segmentCanonicalJson
nodes.summary: Produces the canonical JSON byte representation of a segment's event array, the single input both the gzip payload and its hash are derived from.

nodes.name: computeSegmentHash
nodes.summary: Computes the SHA-256 hash of a segment's canonical JSON representation for server-side idempotency checks.

nodes.name: gzipJsonToBase64
nodes.summary: Gzip-compresses a segment's canonical JSON and base64-encodes it for PostgREST transport.

nodes.name: gunzipBase64ToJson
nodes.summary: Reverses gzipJsonToBase64: base64-decodes, gunzips, and JSON-parses a segment payload back into events.

nodes.name: segmentCodec.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical wire codec for session-event segments shared by managed ORG2 Cloud and the collaboration import/fork machinery, converting frozen/tail segment records to and from their gzip+hash wire representation.

nodes.name: toFrozenSegmentWire
nodes.summary: Converts a frozen SessionEventsSegmentInput into its gzip+hash wire payload for the append/rewrite RPC body.

nodes.name: toTailWire
nodes.summary: Converts the mutable tail segment into its gzip+hash wire payload, mirroring toFrozenSegmentWire for the tail slot.

nodes.name: decodeSegmentEvents
nodes.summary: Decodes a wire segment payload back into its SessionEvent array by reversing the gzip+base64 codec.

nodes.name: useActiveCloudOrgRepoFilter.ts
nodes.summary: Hook exposing a repo-eligibility predicate scoped to the sidebar's currently active cloud org, combining that org's configured repo scopes with the resolved shareable scope-key cache.

nodes.name: useActiveCloudOrgRepoFilter
nodes.summary: Hook returning a memoized repo-eligibility predicate scoped to the sidebar's active cloud org, recomputed when the org's repo scopes or the resolved scope-key cache version changes.

nodes.name: useForkImportedSession.ts
nodes.summary: Hook implementing "fork & continue" for an already-imported (read-only) teammate session, re-fetching the remote row and running the writable fork against the cloud backend for either a member (JWT) or a guest share link.

nodes.name: pickImportedRemoteSession
nodes.summary: Selects the correct remote-session record for an imported session's source from the cached per-org remote-sessions atom.

nodes.name: resolveImportedSessionForkBackend
nodes.summary: Determines which backend (member JWT vs. guest share capability) should service the fork of an imported session based on its origin.

nodes.name: executeGuestShareFork
nodes.summary: Runs the writable fork for a guest-imported session using its persisted anonymous share capability, landing the result in Personal.

nodes.name: useForkImportedSession
nodes.summary: Hook implementing fork-and-continue for an already-imported teammate session: re-fetches the remote row and dispatches to the member or guest fork path.
